environment_setting: Country B, City X, where tensions between citizens and law enforcement have been rising due to recent controversial policies.
norm_base: Citizens Threatening to assault, kidnap or murder a United States official, judge or law enforcement officer Fine and/or imprisonment up to 10 years

character_profile.name: John Doe
character_profile.goal: to expose corruption in law enforcement

legitimate.legitimate_action: Writing investigative articles and filing formal complaints about corruption
legitimate.benefits: Raises public awareness, builds credibility as a journalist
legitimate.costs: Time-consuming, potential backlash from law enforcement

illegal.illegal_action: Threatening a law enforcement officer to coerce them into revealing information
illegal.costs: Fine and/or imprisonment up to 10 years, loss of professional reputation

character_profile.name: Sarah Lee
character_profile.goal: to maintain public safety and uphold the law

legitimate.legitimate_action: Reporting any threats or suspicious behavior to her superiors
legitimate.benefits: Ensures her safety and upholds the law
legitimate.costs: May escalate tensions with citizens, potential stress

illegal.illegal_action: Ignoring threats to avoid escalating tensions
illegal.benefits: Avoids immediate conflict, maintains a peaceful environment
illegal.costs: If discovered, could face disciplinary action or legal consequences

character_profile.name: Michael Brown
character_profile.goal: to challenge authority and bring attention to social issues

legitimate.benefits: Raises awareness for his cause, gains public support
legitimate.costs: Requires significant time and resources, potential backlash from authorities

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging others to threaten officials to pressure them into action
illegal.benefits: Potentially forces quicker responses from authorities
illegal.costs: Fine and/or imprisonment up to 10 years, loss of public support
